svg.aria-label: 2 passes of a radix sort on the keys 53, 21, 37, 28, 15, 31. Each pass shows 3 rows. Pass 1, by the ones digit: the keys colored by their digit; a histogram row of counts for digits 0 to 9, 0 2 0 1 0 1 0 1 1 0; the exclusive scan of the counts, 0 0 2 2 3 3 4 4 5 6; and the output 21 31 53 15 37 28 in groups of color. Pass 2, by the tens digit: counts 0 1 2 2 0 1 and starts 0 0 1 3 5 5, and the sorted output 15 21 28 31 37 53.
svg.text: Each pass: count the digits, scan the counts, place the keys.
Each key goes to start[digit], and start[digit] then grows by 1. After the tens pass the
keys are in order, because the ones order survives inside each tens group.
